audit.why: Chart reads Skill, Cassiopeia x5, Skill on both layers and audits/top/cassiopeia__singed.json proposes exactly that shape from her side, so the two directions agree. The singed packet objects that a 56.04% win rate should not give her five stages; that is a real tension, but it is the mirror's call and I did not fight it.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown number appears anywhere, and the level-6 and 2-item spikes are argued against 'Insanity Potion regen' and 'your regeneration'.
audit.why: Miasma is 24s at rank 1 — by far the longest cooldown in her kit and the actual thing to count. Noxious Blast is 3.5s, Twin Fang 0.75s, Petrifying Gaze 120s. Insanity Potion has no heal or regen in Riot's text; what it does at 6 is put Grievous Wounds on Poison Trail, which halves the Twin Fang healing her whole lane runs on.
audit.corrected: 24s Miasma, 120s Petrifying Gaze and the 100s anti-heal written into the cooldown row, spikes, whys, mid and late.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry treats Miasma's grounding as the thing that beats Singed — 'grounds you, dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it', 'completely cancels this', 'shuts you out cold' — in six separate strings. Singed has no dash and no movement ability in his kit, so the grounding takes nothing from him; it is the slow and the poison chip that hurt. Meanwhile the two interactions that actually matter are absent: Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds against Twin Fang's heal, and Petrifying Gaze only stunning enemies who are facing her.
audit.why: Riot text — Cassiopeia W: 'slowing, grounding, and lightly damaging enemies that pass through them. Grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities.' Cassiopeia E: 'heals her for a percentage of the damage dealt'. Cassiopeia R: 'stunning any enemies in front of her that are facing her and slowing any others with their back turned'. Singed's kit has no dash flag anywhere; his mobility is Noxious Slipstream's passive speed and Insanity Potion's stats, neither of which grounding touches.
audit.corrected: The grounding is re-described honestly as empty against this kit, the slow named as the real problem, and both missing interactions written in — including the rule that turning your back on Petrifying Gaze downgrades a stun to a slow.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing about which way you should be facing when her ultimate goes off, and 'rooted in your cloud via Mega Adhesive' claims a root the adhesive does not have on its own.
audit.why: Petrifying Gaze splits its effect on facing, which is the rare case where a Singed running away is mechanically rewarded. And the root exists only when Fling drops her inside the adhesive.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are where you stop playing a laning game and start playing a macro game. Proxy farm between her tower and the river — she cannot walk into your Poison Trail to stop it, and if she does, Fling her into the sticky zone and disengage. At level 6, Insanity Potion is your green light to run at her during Miasma's cooldown: the stat dump makes you tanky enough to eat one rotation of Noxious Blast and Twin Fang, and your movement speed means she cannot kite you off once you have closed the gap. Track her Miasma cooldown the way you would track a Fiora W — when it is down, she cannot ground you, and your pattern becomes free.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are where you stop playing a laning game and start playing a macro game. Proxy farm between her tower and the river — she cannot walk into your Poison Trail to stop it, and if she does, Fling her into Mega Adhesive, because landing in the goo is what roots her. At level 6 Insanity Potion is the green light, but not for the reason the stat bar suggests: the Grievous Wounds it puts on your trail halves Twin Fang's heal, which is the engine of her whole lane. Count Miasma — 24 seconds at rank 1, the longest cooldown either of you owns — and commit while it is down. Its grounding takes nothing from a kit with no dash; it is the slow you are waiting out.

edits.before: Rylai's Crystal Scepter is the item that flips this lane into your favour on the macro map: every enemy who wanders near your Poison Trail is now perma-slowed, and Cassiopeia cannot peel for her team if she is rooted in your cloud via Mega Adhesive. At two full items her Twin Fang burst climbs high enough to out-pace your regeneration in a straight 1v1, so do not try to kill her — send her team to deal with her while you split-push and drain every objective she cannot be in two places to stop. The 56% win rate comes entirely from proxy pressure and side-lane attrition, not from beating her in a direct fight.
edits.after: Rylai's Crystal Scepter flips this lane on the macro map: everyone near your Poison Trail is perma-slowed, and a Cassiopeia flung into Mega Adhesive is rooted where she lands and cannot peel for anyone. At two items her Twin Fang chain out-damages what your stats absorb, and Insanity Potion is anti-heal rather than regen, so do not try to kill her — send her team to deal with her while you split and drain the objectives she cannot reach. If a fight starts on top of you, keep your back turned: Petrifying Gaze stuns only enemies facing it. The 56% win rate comes from proxy pressure, not head-on fights.

notes: The biggest error here is subtle and repeated six times: the entry builds the whole matchup around Miasma's grounding shutting Singed down, but Singed has no dash and no movement ability for grounding to remove. The slow is the real problem. Also removed 'Insanity Potion regen' twice and a root credited to Mega Adhesive alone. Added the two facts that were missing and matter most: Grievous Wounds on Poison Trail halves Twin Fang's heal, and Petrifying Gaze only stuns enemies facing her — a running Singed takes the slow instead. NOT ASSERTED: whether being Grounded blocks Flash. It very likely matters here, but it is not in Riot's text and singed.json needsResearch is empty, so I left it out. Level chart left alone per the mirror.
